chronology.prior_void_is_not_measurement: TRAF-65 job 198968 is procedure-defect evidence only.
chronology.prohibited_writeback: No TRAF-70 observation may change expectations.json or expectations.md. A changed rule requires a new study version and a new unscored freeze.
chronology.rule: Commit this record before the corrected harness and before any timed TRAF-70 cell.
chronology.scored_cell_definition: A cell becomes scored when a hardware attempt with this freeze digest writes its immutable plan.json.

RX_CREDIT_RETURN_LATENCY.identify_when: The recovery threshold repeats within one frozen gap point and predicts dependent round-trip and post-burst recovery within 10 percent or 1 microsecond.
RX_CREDIT_RETURN_LATENCY.inconclusive_when: No recovery threshold, timer resolution, or a fatal guard.
observations: completion and drain time
first inter-burst gap that restores at least 95 percent of plateau
payload and effective-credit cross checks
RX_CREDIT_RETURN_LATENCY.refute_when: A different guarded latency is the unique cross-case fit.

RX_DELIVERY.identify_when: Every applicable isolated and ordered-frame row has identical expected and observed destination bytes, zero missing, duplicate and out-of-order extents, and a matching sequence digest. This measures behavioral conformance, not hidden implementation.
RX_DELIVERY.inconclusive_when: Any checksum or order field is unavailable or a fatal guard fires.
observations: expected destination byte SHA-256
observed destination byte SHA-256
extent sequence digest, missing, duplicate and out-of-order counts
RX_DELIVERY.refute_when: A guarded repeatable mismatch identifies a different delivered behavior.

RX_EFFECTIVE_BUFFER.identify_when: A loss-free first knee repeats within one sweep point across incast and outstanding arms, localizes to one destination, and the same effective capacity predicts drain.
RX_EFFECTIVE_BUFFER.inconclusive_when: No localized knee, no common capacity, or a fatal guard.
observations: offered in-flight bytes at the first destination knee
destination raw ingress, completion and post-burst drain time
checksum loss, duplication and order ledger
RX_EFFECTIVE_BUFFER.refute_when: A different guarded effective capacity uniquely predicts both knee and drain.

RX_INGRESS_RATE.identify_when: The median of the three highest unthrottled destination raw-ingress plateaus is repeatable within 10 percent, checksum complete, and at or below 300 GB/s.
RX_INGRESS_RATE.inconclusive_when: No plateau or any applicable fatal guard.
observations: destination GPU per-link raw_rx deltas
destination aggregate raw ingress rate
source-count, skew, burst and region controls
RX_INGRESS_RATE.refute_when: A repeatable guarded plateau differs from the candidate by more than 10 percent.

SWITCH_DIRECT_MESH_IDENTITY.identify_when: The topology remains a direct GPU mesh and endpoint counters conserve bytes. This retains pass-through as a structural invariant only; it never promotes a physical switch timing, FIFO, arbitration or buffer parameter to measured.
SWITCH_DIRECT_MESH_IDENTITY.inconclusive_when: Topology or endpoint counters are unavailable.
observations: four-GPU NV4 topology and remote-link mapping
source TX versus destination RX counter conservation
absence of an enumerated NVSwitch hop
SWITCH_DIRECT_MESH_IDENTITY.refute_when: An enumerated intermediate switch or guarded endpoint byte mismatch exists.

TX_EFFECTIVE_CREDITS.identify_when: The first 95-percent knee repeats within one sweep point for every payload arm, scales with the independently fitted wire-byte unit, is destination-scoped in cases 62 to 64, and returns after the frozen recovery gap. The fitted quantities are effective, never register claims.
TX_EFFECTIVE_CREDITS.inconclusive_when: No common knee, an occupancy-only knee, counter quantization, or a guard.
observations: applied outstanding window and offered in-flight bytes
per-direction raw bytes and completion rate
first 95-percent knee across payload, burst and gap controls
TX_EFFECTIVE_CREDITS.refute_when: A reproducible guarded knee identifies different effective unit or count values.

TX_ENDPOINT_EGRESS_RATE.identify_when: The median of the three highest unthrottled source raw-egress plateaus is within 10 percent across repeats and no constituent link exceeds 25 GB/s.
TX_ENDPOINT_EGRESS_RATE.inconclusive_when: No plateau, throttling, counter unavailability, or another fatal guard.
observations: sum of one source GPU's per-link raw_tx deltas
three-destination fanout elapsed time
throttle verdict and all per-link ceiling checks
TX_ENDPOINT_EGRESS_RATE.refute_when: A repeatable unthrottled plateau differs from the candidate by more than 10 percent.

TX_LINK_COUNT_RATE_AND_BOND.bond_policy_limit: Balanced aggregate counters identify four-link balanced striping only. They do not identify earliest-available scheduling. Keep that exact policy declared unless a packet-order observable distinguishes it.
TX_LINK_COUNT_RATE_AND_BOND.identify_when: Every ordered pair has one stable active-link count, each active link remains at or below 25 GB/s, saturated minimum-over-maximum balance is at least 0.90, and the median of each link's three highest unthrottled plateaus is repeatable within 10 percent. This identifies the link count and measured effective per-link rate.
TX_LINK_COUNT_RATE_AND_BOND.inconclusive_when: No saturation plateau exists or any applicable fatal guard fires.
observations: remote-GPU-mapped per-link raw_tx deltas
per-link elapsed rate at ordered-pair saturation
balance under payload, stream, burst, direction and pair sweeps
TX_LINK_COUNT_RATE_AND_BOND.refute_when: A stable count differs from the candidate, a link exceeds the physical ceiling, or saturated traffic remains imbalanced below 0.90 after control sweeps.

candidate_blind_search.tolerance: one 1024-byte counter quantum per active link and direction

TX_PACKET_PAYLOAD_AND_HEADER.identify_when: One parameter pair is the unique minimum-residual fit for both SM producers, has no producer interaction above one quantum, and predicts every blind holdout within one quantum. Copy-engine rows must agree but cannot rescue an SM failure.
TX_PACKET_PAYLOAD_AND_HEADER.inconclusive_when: No unique pair passes, counters quantize the fit, or a fatal guard fires.
observations: source-side per-link raw_tx and data_tx deltas
payload_bytes and message_count stimulus fields
producer class and applied alignment, access-width, lane-mask, stride and reuse controls
case 16 blind holdout residuals
TX_PACKET_PAYLOAD_AND_HEADER.refute_when: A unique non-candidate pair passes, or only copy-engine rows fit the candidate. Publish the passing fitted values or the copy-engine-only refutation literally.

TX_REQUEST_RESPONSE_DIRECTION.identify_when: Writes carry observed data source-to-destination; reads carry nonzero raw-only request traffic issuer-to-target and observed data target-to-issuer, consistently for all direction controls.
TX_REQUEST_RESPONSE_DIRECTION.inconclusive_when: Raw-only request traffic is below counter resolution or a guard fires.
observations: write source raw_tx/data_tx and destination raw_rx/data_rx
read issuer raw_tx/data_tx and raw_rx/data_rx
read target raw_rx/data_rx and raw_tx/data_tx
TX_REQUEST_RESPONSE_DIRECTION.refute_when: A guarded direction ledger consistently differs from that mapping.

TX_RX_QUEUE_SCOPE.identify_when: Other-peer interference from one source identifies TX scope; remote incast into one destination identifies RX scope; same-pair and region controls must preserve the localization. A shared-cache-line-only effect is memory acceptance.
TX_RX_QUEUE_SCOPE.inconclusive_when: No stable localized asymmetry or any fatal guard.
observations: latency-flow and bulk-flow completion ledger
same-pair, other-peer, remote-incast, direction and region controls
per-link and per-direction raw/data deltas
TX_RX_QUEUE_SCOPE.refute_when: Guarded localization consistently contradicts the candidate module ownership.

fatal_guards.decidable_when: all named fields are present for every hardware row
fatal_guards.pass_when: checksums and sequence digests match and all three counts are zero

fatal_guards.decidable_when: before and after guard records plus row link maps are complete
fatal_guards.fatal_when: non-NV4, an intermediate path, missing peer access, or topology change
observables: four A100-SXM4-80GB identities before and after
CUDA peer-access result for every ordered pair
fatal_guards.pass_when: all four observations name the same direct NV4 mesh with peer access

fatal_guards.decidable_when: every active GPU link has both snapshots and statuses
fatal_guards.fatal_when: unsupported, missing, reset, ambiguous wrap, or non-monotone counter
observables: counter API return status and timestamp
fatal_guards.pass_when: all statuses are success and every modulo-safe delta is nonnegative

fatal_guards.fatal_when: raw is below data beyond one 1024-byte quantum
fatal_guards.pass_when: raw is at least data in each link direction after one-quantum allowance

fatal_guards.decidable_when: all five before and after counters and statuses exist per active link
fatal_guards.fatal_when: any unexplained nominal delta is nonzero

fatal_guards.decidable_when: FG03 passes and elapsed time is positive
fatal_guards.fatal_when: any ceiling including its frozen 1 percent timer allowance is exceeded
observables: per-link raw directional delta and elapsed time
ordered-pair raw directional sum and elapsed time
per-GPU raw directional sum and elapsed time
fatal_guards.pass_when: rates are at most 25.25, 101 and 303 GB/s respectively

fatal_guards.decidable_when: all row telemetry and both cell process snapshots exist
fatal_guards.fatal_when: thermal or hardware slowdown, power-brake, unknown throttle, competitor, or nonexclusive allocation
observables: before and after clock-event reason masks
SM and memory clocks, power and temperature
fatal_guards.pass_when: verdict is CLEAR, no fatal clock-event bit is set, and no competing process exists

fatal_guards.decidable_when: the complete input and effect ledgers are present
fatal_guards.fatal_when: any parsed-only control, digest mismatch, or one copy-engine host enqueue per message
observables: copy_engine_batch_mode, host enqueue count and logical message count
fatal_guards.pass_when: every named input is present in the effect ledger, the canonical digest matches, and copy-engine rows use one batched or graph enqueue rather than one host enqueue per message

fatal_guards.decidable_when: raw rows and scorer fit trace are available
fatal_guards.fatal_when: a candidate-derived field is labeled or consumed as an observation
fatal_guards.pass_when: rows contain no candidate_packet_count, candidate_raw_bytes, predicted counter, or candidate-valued observation field and the scorer enumerates its full search grid

fatal_guards.decidable_when: all named timing and terminal fields are present
fatal_guards.fatal_when: missing completion, negative ordering, timeout, or terminal mismatch
fatal_guards.pass_when: times are ordered and every expected extent has exactly one terminal

global_acceptance.fatal_guard_requirement: every guard is decidable and passes for each applicable scope
global_acceptance.flow_dynamics_gate: Open only if all 86 cells complete, every fatal guard is decidable, and the score publishes a non-void verdict for link bonding, effective credits, RX ingress/buffer, and queue-scope observability.
global_acceptance.held_out_error: at most 10 percent or 1 microsecond, whichever is larger
global_acceptance.parameter_publication: Only a parameter with an IDENTIFIED or REFUTED result from its named rule may change value or evidence class.

observation_contract.candidate_separation: Candidate-derived packet counts, raw bytes and expected parameter values are forbidden from observation fields.
observation_contract.checksum_contract: SHA-256 over bytes copied back from the actual delivery destination, compared to independently generated expected bytes.
observation_contract.copy_engine_contract: One batched 2D transfer or one CUDA graph launch per flow/stream; never one host enqueue per logical message.
observation_contract.direction_vocabulary: GPU-local TX and RX, with remote GPU and physical link IDs recorded
observation_contract.order_contract: Expected and observed extent-sequence digests plus missing, duplicate and out-of-order counts.
observation_contract.raw_data_units: NVML throughput-counter KiB, converted to bytes only as observed_kib * 1024

protected_inputs_until_score_publication.rule: Both files remain byte-identical until the TRAF-70 score is published. Afterward only parameters literally identified by these rules may change.

target.array_pacing: short cells, at most one four-GPU cell active with %1
target.node_shape: one exclusive qualified four-A100-SXM4-80GB NV4 node
target.ssh_loss: staging is atomic and scheduler signals write a clean resumable stop record
